voice.name: Roger - Laid-Back, Casual, Resonant
voice.why: The sawmill foreman is easy-going and dry, a man who talks over the noise of a saw without raising his voice. Roger is a laid-back middle-aged American with a resonant but lighter tone than Bruno's baritone.

greet.text: Lucien Maury. I keep the saws running at the Everon mill. Bring logs, and I will keep you busy.

next_top.text: I have nothing left to show you. You know every saw in this yard.
